## 检查清单 / Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` 通过（防泄露扫描 + 类型检查 + 测试）/ passes (leak scan + typecheck + tests)
- [ ] 新机制是默认关闭的开关，关闭时输出与之前逐字节一致，并有单元测试 / new mechanisms are off-by-default switches, byte-identical when off, with unit tests
- [ ] 只改注释 / 文档时，没有改动行为 / comment- or doc-only changes do not change behavior
- [ ] 宣称“更好”时附了配对比较（同一世界、同一题号；见 `docs/benchmark.md`）/ claims of "better" include a paired comparison
- [ ] 中文文档改了的，对应的 `.en.md` 也同步了 / bilingual docs updated together
- [ ] **没有**提交任何真实对话、日记、self.md / seed.md、记忆库、会话日志、密钥、服务器地址或账号 / **no** real conversations, diaries, memory databases, session logs, secrets, server addresses or accounts
